license_gate: Supervisor confirmation of non-commercial research use is required before execution.
architecture: Official DEIMv2-S with DINOv3-S-distilled ViT-Tiny, STA, LiteEncoder, and four-layer DEIM decoder
class_mapping: All ForestPersons categories map to internal person label 0; COCO person row initializes one-class heads.
augmentation: None for the controlled two-epoch pilot; fixed 640x640 resize and ImageNet normalization.
model_selection: Final epoch only; val600 is not used for checkpoint selection.
operating_point: Select confidence threshold on disjoint train-derived calibration100 at FP/image <= 0.425, then lock it for val600.
